about: Custom types P4: a cell's monster_art takes a custom type's name (wolf, like goblin): the block is kept under the type's id and a wolf in the cell draws its start strip. A class's monster_art naming wolf is one mod error. A like-ogre type (bear) is held to the ogre rule (hand needs a line on every body). Fix wave: art for wolf on a cell that never calls wolves (no mon_types) is the 'never calls' error (I2); a wolf-only cell's wolf block counts as monster strips for an intermission and its strips are checked (M2); a wolf draws the cell's own mon_spr_wolf set before the goblin block (M3).
